The '''G51 communications array''' was a [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]]&ndash;wide communications array which had been commissioned by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Empress]] [[Marasiah Fel]] following the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] in [[138 ABY]] to improve communications between the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and to link them to the wider galaxy. While Empress Fel regarded the communications array as essential to investing in the future of the new [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] regarded the communications array as "window dressing" and as one of the Empress' vanity projects.

The G51 communications array was known to have a [[Carreras G51 communications array|station]] in the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]] and a [[Ithori system secondary communications array outpost|secondary communications array outpost]] in the [[Ithori system/Legends|Ithori system]]. During the [[Carreras Incident]], the Carreras array was destroyed when it collided with the floating planet [[Mala (planet)|Mala]].
